visaPhoto.title: Passport-photo spec for your visa
visaPhoto.intro: Korea's visa photo rules are strict — getting them wrong is a common reason applications are delayed or rejected:
visaPhoto.p1: 35 × 45 mm, plain white background (a software-replaced background is not accepted).
visaPhoto.p2: Face 70–80% of the photo height, front view, neutral expression.
visaPhoto.p3: Taken within the last 6 months; no hat, generally no glasses, no retouching.
visaPhoto.p4: Online upload (Korea Visa Portal): JPEG under 200 KB, at least 413 × 531 px.
visaPhoto.source: Based on the Korea Visa Portal (visa.go.kr) and consulate rules — confirm your own consulate's exact requirements.
